training: 80 weakly labelled 60 s TRAIN bags; 29 windows per bag; top-2 multiple-instance pooling
selection: human DEV windows only, for epoch and probability threshold
criterion_rationale: F1 is unsuitable as a selection criterion at roughly 12 percent window prevalence: it barely penalises false positives, so an F1 sweep drifts towards always-yes. Balanced accuracy weights the negative class equally. Criterion fixed before any TEST scoring.
